## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

**1. Global Risk Regime?**
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 6/11 sectors positive. VXX (1W: +2.60% | 1M: -10.53%) RECOVERY rising and SPY (1W: -0.35% | 1M: +2.19%) CORRECTION flat signal mixed risk sentiment alongside a modestly wider credit spread (Credit Spread 1W: +0.01% | 1M: +0.61%) ABOVE TREND.

**2. Primary Risk Drivers?**
Fear uptick: VXX (1W: +2.60% | 1M: -10.53%) RECOVERY ↑ rising. Credit conditions mixed-to-weak: HYG (1W: +0.11% | 1M: +1.01%) ABOVE TREND but Credit Spread (1W: +0.01% | 1M: +0.61%) ABOVE TREND points to mild stress; small-cap/speculative appetite intact via IWM (1W: +2.13% | 1M: +6.35%) ABOVE TREND ↑ rising.

**3. Financial Conditions Signal?**
Neutral-to-mixed: TLT (1W: -0.15% | 1M: +0.30%) CORRECTION and SPY (1W: -0.35% | 1M: +2.19%) CORRECTION show stocks vs bonds flat; yield-curve and dollar readings are modestly supportive of balanced positioning (Yield Curve ↑ flat, Dollar Strength ↑ flat).

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

**4. Sector Leadership?**
Cyclicals/commodities leading: XLE (1W: +2.19% | 1M: +9.78%) ABOVE TREND and Materials/Industrials (XME 1W: +6.19% | 1M: +23.17% ABOVE TREND; ITA 1W: +4.64% | 1M: +17.23% ABOVE TREND) showing strength. Tech mixed: XLK (1W: -0.36% | 1M: +2.30%) CORRECTION while Financials showing short-term weakness in breadth (Financials sector 1W: -1.25% | 1M: +0.38%) — Style: mixed, cyclicals nudging ahead.

**5. US vs Global?**
US mixed but resilient: SPY (1W: -0.35% | 1M: +2.19%) CORRECTION while EM/Emerging risk-on pockets: EEM (1W: +1.28% | 1M: +9.23%) ABOVE TREND and FXI (1W: -0.13% | 1M: +3.53%) CORRECTION show regional dispersion; Europe/Japan readings are broadly ABOVE TREND.

**6. Speculative Appetite?**
Speculative flows present: IBIT (1W: +6.02% | 1M: +9.11%) ABOVE TREND and ARKK (1W: +1.73% | 1M: +1.92%) ABOVE TREND; small caps IWM (1W: +2.13% | 1M: +6.35%) ABOVE TREND confirm risk-on pockets despite mixed large-cap internals.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

**7. Commodities Theme?**
Precious metals and selective commodities strong: SLV (1W: +11.94% | 1M: +40.34%) ABOVE TREND and GLD (1W: +1.65% | 1M: +6.42%) ABOVE TREND; copper/industrial signals show CPER (1W: -0.58% | 1M: +9.27%) CORRECTION—commodities-led reflation theme but with short-term profit-taking.

**8. Energy Trend?**
Energy broadly strong: BNO (1W: +1.77% | 1M: +9.71%) ABOVE TREND and XLE (1W: +2.19% | 1M: +9.78%) ABOVE TREND indicate demand-driven support; UNG (1W: -0.67% | 1M: -14.63%) BELOW TREND remains weak.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

**9. Trend Confirmation?**
CONFIRMED on pockets: IWM (1W: +2.13% | 1M: +6.35%) ABOVE TREND, EEM (1W: +1.28% | 1M: +9.23%) ABOVE TREND, XLE (1W: +2.19% | 1M: +9.78%) ABOVE TREND. MAJOR Divergence across cores (SPY, XLK, QQQ showing 1W negative vs 1M positive) suppresses a clear directional call—treat market as transitional.

**10. Portfolio Direction?**
Favor cyclicals/commodity-exposed ETFs showing strength (XLE (1W: +2.19% | 1M: +9.78%) ABOVE TREND, XME proxies) and maintain exposure to small-cap/speculative pockets (IWM (1W: +2.13% | 1M: +6.35%) ABOVE TREND); reduce exposure to areas showing short-term momentum fatigue (XLK (1W: -0.36% | 1M: +2.30%) CORRECTION, QQQ (1W: -0.86% | 1M: +1.69%) CORRECTION).

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Sectors to Watch?**
BULLISH: Energy/Materials — XLE (1W: +2.19% | 1M: +9.78%) ABOVE TREND and XME/ITA momentum. BEARISH: Communications/Tech internals — XLC (1W: -2.32% | 1M: -0.95%) BELOW TREND and XLK (1W: -0.36% | 1M: +2.30%) CORRECTION.

**12. Commodities to Watch?**
BULLISH: Silver/Precious metals — SLV (1W: +11.94% | 1M: +40.34%) ABOVE TREND, GLD (1W: +1.65% | 1M: +6.42%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: Natural gas — UNG (1W: -0.67% | 1M: -14.63%) BELOW TREND.

**13. Key Levels?**
VXX  (1W: +2.60% | 1M: -10.53%) RECOVERY ~ watch 26-30 for volatility regime shift; HYG (1W: +0.11% | 1M: +1.01%) ABOVE TREND / LQD (1W: -0.06% | 1M: +0.41%) CORRECTION to monitor credit; XLK/XLF Tech vs Financials ratio (1W: +0.75% | 1M: +4.63%) ABOVE TREND as pivot for style rotation.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL. Breadth: 6/11 sectors positive, mixed signals from rising VXX and flat SPY/TLT. Cyclicals and commodities (XLE, XME, SLV) showing relative strength while Tech (XLK) and large-cap growth (QQQ) exhibit short-term weakness to monitor.
